title: Top bar with a hanging logo and a cream download tab: a 75-unit black bar, nav on a 139-unit pitch with a gold current item and underline, a logo mark hanging 62 units below the bar
use: The fixed top bar of a game's official site. current picks the highlighted nav item (1-7).
relations: Bar 75 units; the logo hangs 62 units below it; nav items 139 wide from x 353; the current item is gold at 24 units with a full-width 3-unit underline.
The download tab is 225 x 81 visible, top edge at the canvas top, only the bottom-left corner rounded (22.5); it is taller than the bar.
decoration: Logo ring mark, music button, divider, avatar, star dust: drawn.

provenance.corpus: vesperwake case (长庚航志 VESPERWAKE): our own original one-page game site and two in-game screens in the celestial-voyage grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/celestial-voyage/style.json provenance (reference site measured privately; captures never shipped)
provenance.method: The case's top bar at 1920 with the reference's measured positions (computed styles of the bar, nav items and tab).
measured: Reference: bar 75 high rgba(0,0,0,.8); nav 139 wide from x 353, 22.5 units #747474, current 24 units #E1B066; tab 225 x 83 at (1695, -2), bottom-left radius 22.5, text 28.5 units 700 #1C1919.
